title: COWL VENTILATOR & KICK PANEL
summary: Cowl (kick panel) fresh-air vent controls: push-pull rod & tube cables run from the two vent control levers/knobs at the heater control housing under the dash to the vent valves in the left and right kick panels. The cable tube is clamped at the control housing with a screw and nut, the knobs are held with a set screw, the vent valve sits in the dash panel outlet with its bracket spot-welded to the dash panel, and the kick panel cover (the vent grille panel) is screwed on.

parts.name: ROD & TUBE ASM.

fastening.note: Screw [3] and nut [4] clamp the tube end of rod & tube [1] at the control lever bracket.
View A: nut [4] goes on the pivot stud of the vent control lever.
View A: knob [2] pushes on the lever and is locked by a set screw (unnumbered 'SCREW', torque 2).
Note 1A: spotweld bracket [6] to dash panel, 3 places.
View B: valve [5] sits in the kick-panel outlet on bracket [6]; rod [1] connects to its lever. .120/.124 dia hole in the dash panel outlet.
View B: screw [7] clamps the rod & tube [1] end at the valve bracket.
View B: screw [9] goes in through the cover [8] from the passenger side.

notes: Adjust the cowl vent control levers so they sit 0.10 to 0.15 from the seated position when the valve assembly is fully closed.
